info.title: ClientLedger Trial Balance engine
info.description: Desktop-mode API of the Vibe Trial Balance engine. Every response uses the { data, error, meta } envelope. Amounts are integer cents.

start_date.description: DATE column, serialized as UTC midnight

end_date.description: DATE column, serialized as UTC midnight

ChartAccount.description: One account on a client chart of accounts (the import picks accounts from these, Q37).

TrialBalanceRow.description: One account on the adjusted trial balance (view v_adjusted_trial_balance). Each stage is a debit/credit pair in cents.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole file, hex

idMappings.description: Per table, archive id -> restored id

fileName.description: A desktop full backup in BACKUPS_DIR

clientId.description: The client id inside that backup

outName.description: The client .tbak to write in BACKUPS_DIR

TbTotals.description: Column totals of GET /periods/{periodId}/trial-balance, summed by PostgreSQL over the same rows.

ClientSummary.description: One period of an active client, as the Clients screen shows it (Q16).

last_worked.description: Newest change to the trial balance, an entry or a task

expectedUpdatedAt.description: row_updated_at as read; 409 STALE_WRITE when the row changed since

JournalEntryLineInput.description: One line: a debit or a credit, never both, never zero

isRecurring.description: Copied into the next period at roll-forward

JournalEntryUpdate.description: Header fields and, when given, all lines (replaced in one transaction). Changing entryType keeps the entry number, which can collide with an entry of the other type (the desktop does not offer it).

JournalEntryCreated.description: The new entry; its lines echo the request (no account number or name)

CsvColumnMapping.description: A mapping the user chose (lib/csvColumnMapping.ts); replaces the guess.

csvRow.description: Line index in the file, from 0

fallbackMode.description: The columns were guessed without AI

AccountUpdate.description: Fields to change on an account (only those sent). W/P ref, notes and lead sheet belong to the account, so they show in every period. An empty string clears a text field.

leadSheetId.description: One of the client's lead sheets; null clears it

Tickmark.description: One mark in a client's tickmark library

AccountTickmarks.description: Marks on each account for a period, keyed by account id

BankTransaction.description: One bank transaction. amount is cents, positive = money into the bank account. A row is posted (an entry_type trans journal entry) when it has an account, a source account and a period.

amount.description: cents (a string in the PATCH answer: the row as written)

BankTransactionUpdate.description: Only the fields sent change. A null accountId or periodId unposts the row.

BankRowsImport.description: Bank rows parsed by the desktop (OFX, QFX, QIF, CSV) or read from a PDF statement. Duplicates are keyed as the engine's own file import keys them (date, description, amount, check number, source account, occurrence in this request). Rows with no date, no description or a zero amount are left out and not counted.

BankStatementAnalysis.description: What the AI read from a bank statement PDF; nothing is written. Amounts are cents, positive = money in. Opening and closing balances are as the AI wrote them (cents, not rounded) and may be missing.

date.description: As the AI wrote it (asked for YYYY-MM-DD)

visionMode.description: The pages were read as images

transactions.description: The account's bank rows dated on or before the statement date, less those cleared in an earlier completed reconciliation

visionMode.description: The pages were read as images (a scanned PDF)

LlmProvider.description: AI settings. The desktop uses provider claude (key from the OS keychain, handed to the engine as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, never stored here), ollama, or openai-compat (a local server; no key).
